professionalSummary.text: Conducted member research for savings features and translated findings into backlog items
professionalSummary.witness: Interviewed 22 members about saving towards goals and turned the recurring themes into backlog items for a round-up savings feature, ordered by how often each theme came up.

professionalSummary.text: Coordinated delivery with core-banking vendor and internal engineering
professionalSummary.witness: Coordinated sprint planning between the online-banking team and the core-banking vendor's integration engineers through a shared dependency log reviewed each week, and escalated two vendor delays to the vendor's account manager.

professionalSummary.text: Led production release of savings feature with change advisory board approval and post-launch review
professionalSummary.witness: Led the production release of round-up savings on 15 April 2023, five days after change advisory board approval; before that, the feature ran as a member-panel pilot with 300 volunteers in the UAT environment.

professionalSummary.text: Ensured rate and disclosure changes were reviewed by compliance before release
professionalSummary.witness: Sent every rate-sheet and disclosure update to the compliance officer for review before scheduling it, and filed the approval emails with the release record.

professionalSummary.text: Reported feature results to product committee in quarterly report
professionalSummary.witness: Wrote the savings section of the quarterly digital report, which the head of digital presented to the product committee.
